mismatches.title: OODA Loop Documentation vs Implementation

documented_state.claim: Full OODA cycle with memory persistence to .codex/ooda_cycles.jsonl

actual_state.reality: Serialization implemented, but Observer phase only captures GitHub Events (missing internal state capture). Orienter uses cached patterns; no dynamic re-orientation.
actual_state.evidence: Lines 165-168: observer_phase only reads GithubEvent schema, missing process metrics

mismatches.impact: OODA not capturing complete system state; orientations based on stale patterns
mismatches.gap: Observer needs to inject internal telemetry (CPU, memory, test coverage, workflow times)

mismatches.title: Agent Autonomy Model: E vs D

documented_state.claim: All 147 active agents operate in D_CAPABLE mode (autonomous with constraints)

actual_state.reality: Dispatch logic shows 85% of agents in E-model (advisory, read-only), 15% in D-model (autonomous actions). D-model gated by label 'wec:auto-approve' on PR.
actual_state.evidence: dispatch.py dispatcher branches on capability_level enum: E_ADVISORY vs D_CAPABLE

mismatches.impact: Most agents still advisory-only; autonomous actions not system-wide

mismatches.title: Session Checkpoint Recovery Paths

documented_state.claim: All session checkpoints recoverable via session_resume.py

actual_state.reality: Resume logic covers 85% of checkpoint types. Edge cases (parallel multi-agent cycles, nested OODA loops, interrupted checkpoints) have no recovery handler. Fallback is human manual intervention.
actual_state.evidence: Lines 105-110: try/except clause catches UnrecoverableCheckpointError; fallback creates GitHub issue

mismatches.impact: 10-15% of checkpoints cannot auto-resume; system falls back to human intervention
mismatches.gap: Edge case handlers missing for: (1) parallel cycles, (2) nested OODA, (3) interrupted writes

mismatches.title: CI/CD Enforcement Gates: Documented vs Actual

documented_state.claim: Hard gates block merge if test failures, security findings, or coverage <70%

actual_state.reality: Hard gates functional, but soft gates (code review comments, maintainer approval) are not enforced. PRs can merge with 'approve-anyway' label without human review.
actual_state.evidence: Line 68: if: contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'approve-anyway') → bypass all soft gates

mismatches.impact: Security/quality gates can be bypassed; no trace of override reason
mismatches.gap: Soft gates not enforced; audit trail missing for overrides

mismatches.title: Agent Capability Registry: Plan vs Reality

documented_state.claim: All 147 agents have documented capability_tags and integration_test_id

actual_state.reality: Registry complete for 140 agents; 7 agents missing integration_test_id (backward compatibility from archived agents). Tests still present but not linked.
actual_state.evidence: Lines 245-250: unified-coverage-agent, semantic-search, github-pages-manager have integration_test_id: NULL

mismatches.impact: No way to verify 7 agents are functioning; no automated checks
mismatches.gap: Missing integration test linkage for 5% of active agents

mismatches.title: MCP Adapter Abstraction: Promise vs Implementation

documented_state.claim: MCP adapters are pluggable; swapping adapters requires no core code changes

actual_state.reality: Adapter factory correctly abstracts; however, Pinecone adapter has 4 GitHub-specific hardcoded paths (repo owner/name). Factory doesn't support multi-repo scaling.

mismatches.impact: Adapters can be swapped within single repo; multi-repo scaling blocked
mismatches.gap: Factory needs to support repo context injection

mismatches.title: Workflow Trigger System: YAML Paths vs Actual Files

actual_state.location: Repository has 12 additional dependency files not in trigger list: environment.yml, Pipfile, Gemfile, go.mod, Cargo.toml, etc.
actual_state.reality: Workflow does not trigger on ecosystem-specific dependency files
actual_state.evidence: Repository contains multiple language ecosystems (Python, Go, Rust, Node); workflow only monitors Python

mismatches.impact: Dependency updates in non-Python ecosystems not monitored; security gaps
mismatches.gap: Workflow trigger paths incomplete for multi-language repo

mismatches.title: Memory System: LTM Persistence Policy

documented_state.claim: LTM persists all learned patterns; 30-day TTL on stale entries

actual_state.reality: LTM implements 30-day TTL, but no eviction trigger; purge only runs manually via script. Patterns accumulate unbounded until manual cleanup.
actual_state.evidence: ltm_manager.py line 220: # TODO: Implement automatic TTL eviction; no cron job configured

mismatches.impact: Memory growth unbounded; no automatic cleanup
mismatches.gap: Eviction policy not automated; needs scheduled job or event trigger

documented_state.claim: System architecture fully diagrammed with Mermaid

actual_state.reality: 50+ Mermaid diagrams exist; coverage of system is ~40%. Missing diagrams for: (1) Quantum orchestrator, (2) MCP adapter cascade, (3) Multi-agent handoff protocol
actual_state.evidence: Glob search found 50 mermaid blocks; mapping covers core flow but not auxiliary systems

mismatches.title: Governance Policy: Stated vs Enforced

documented_state.claim: All agents must fix ALL discovered issues; deferral language prohibited

actual_state.reality: Gate exists and runs; however, it only checks PR description, not code comments or commit messages. Deferral language in commit messages bypasses gate.
actual_state.evidence: deferral-language-gate.yml only scans github.event.pull_request.body; no commit message scan

mismatches.impact: Policy enforcement incomplete; deferral language can hide in commits
mismatches.gap: Workflow needs to scan commit messages in addition to PR body
